name: Motion Blur via Vertex Displacement
definition: Motion blur for fluid meshes is obtained by shifting each vertex toward the velocity by the shutter time, using the velocity recorded by the simulation, rather than tracing vertices along a transformation path between frames.
summary: Motion Blur via Vertex Displacement generates blur for volumetric fluid meshes by shifting vertices along velocity vectors, solving the challenge of dynamic mesh topology where traditional time-based tracing is impossible.
